card.name: Sentence-starting the, their, our
card.fires_on: Short determiners or pronouns such as "the", "Their", "The", "I", "our" that start a new clause or sentence in general web prose, mostly Catholic encyclopedia or site-credit text.

modes.label: Determiner after a conjunction
modes.description: "the" right after "and" or a comma, opening a new clause about results or findings.
modes.example: In the determination of the truth the most recent and acknowledged scientific methods are employed, and<< the>> results of the latest research in theology,

modes.label: Sentence-opening pronoun
modes.description: A pronoun or article that begins a new sentence after a full stop.
modes.example: the Church has grown both extensively and intensively among English-speaking peoples.<< Their>> living interests demand that they

card.writes: It promotes odd code-like tokens and suppresses punctuation and line breaks, so it pushes toward a noun phrase continuing rather than ending the sentence.
card.plain: It fires on small opening words like "the" or "their" that begin a new clause in ordinary web text.
